_doc: Optional per-kind overrides (spec 2026-11-03 §3). save_has: userState fields that identify the kind in the save (prefab ids are opaque); state: save field -> one-vocabulary state key ([field, 'bool' | {value: state, '*': default}]); area: name stem for an area where this kind is the main one; markers: state -> frame marker nav can walk to. A kind without an entry still works (raw fields only; named from the log).
